name: Can I stay in my home during a room renovation?

mainEntity.name: Can I stay in my home during a room renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Whether you can stay in your home during a room renovation depends on the scope of work. For minor projects in a single room, it might be feasible, though disruptions like noise, dust, and temporary utility shut-offs are likely. For major renovations like a kitchen or bathroom overhaul, especially those impacting essential services, it's often more practical and safer to arrange temporary accommodation. We discuss these logistics with you during planning.
acceptedAnswer.description: Staying home during renovation depends on the scope; minor projects might allow it, but major overhauls often require temporary relocation due to disruption.
